title: A Bit of Everything
description: Its a mix of various different mods. This modpack makes sure that on a Mod Server there is something for everyone
body: This modpack adds a bit of everything like technology from Create and the create addons, magic from Iron Spells n' Spellbooks and artifacts, guns from Tacz and much more. When you want to play with mods and  friends but you all are enyoing different aspects of Minecraft, this is for you. The mod also features Artifacts to make your life in the Modpack better and the backpacked so your inv is a bit bigger. Theres also some cooking stuff and bakery with the [Lets Do] mods. Camera Mod to capture the best moments and Another Furniture to decorate your factory for example. Alexs Caves for more exploration. Movement? No problem, Parcool!
